summary: Frontend testing of NEW /pgmei3.html emission page and refactor to shared /pgmei-shared.{js,css}. All 7 scenarios passed: (1) page 3 loads with #pg-cnpj='37.411.286/0001-08' and #pg-nome='LUCI SCHIAVI DA SILVA 42017335215' (data from BrasilAPI via /api/consulta-cnpj) plus 'Informe o Ano-Calendário:' label and #btnOk button; (2) bootstrap-select combo is CLOSED on load (no 'open' class), clicking .dropdown-toggle opens it and exposes exactly the 6 years ['2021','2022','2023','2024','2025','2026'] via .dropdown-menu-inner li a, selecting 2024 closes the dropdown and shows '2024' in .filter-option; (3) clicking #btnOk without selecting a year shows red banner #pgmei-banner (class 'show err') with message 'Informe o Ano-Calendário antes de continuar.' and auto-dismisses after ~2s (class becomes ''); (4) selecting 2024 and clicking #btnOk shows the ladda spinner with exactly 12 bars (.pgmei-ladda i) for ~2s and then shows a banner informing 'Apuração do ano-calendário 2024 ainda não disponível nesta versão de estudo.'; (5) Regression on page 3 navbar: 'Consulta Extrato/Pendências' dropdown is CLOSED on load, opens on click showing 3 items, popover #pg-popover 'Acesso restrito' appears on disabled items; (6) Regression on page 2 after refactor: #pg-cnpj and #pg-nome rendered dynamically, dropdown closed on load; (7) Clicking 'Emitir Guia de Pagamento (DAS)' from page 2 navigates to /pgmei3.html?cnpj=37411286000108 preserving CNPJ and shows correct contribuinte on page 3.
critical_code_review_comments: pgmei-shared.js is clean and well-structured (window.PGMEI namespace, no jQuery). The 12-bar ladda spinner is generated inline and the banner auto-dismiss uses setTimeout with fade-out class as expected.
pgmei3.html inherits the SingleFile-captured bulky inline CSS (same pattern as pgmei2.html). Long-term, consider re-capturing or minifying, but functionality is correct.

success_rate.backend: N/A (not requested; endpoint /api/consulta-cnpj validated indirectly via page rendering)

context_for_next_testing_agent: New /pgmei3.html (emissão) + /pgmei-shared.{js,css} refactor are fully validated. Combo Ano-Calendário has years 2021-2026, closed by default, selectable via [data-testid='ano-opcao-YYYY']. Banner uses #pgmei-banner with classes 'show err' and auto-dismisses after ~2s. Navbar 'Emitir Guia de Pagamento (DAS)' link correctly points to /pgmei3.html?cnpj=... and preserves CNPJ. No regressions on page 2.
